liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Garcia has equipment trouble at the start and shouts in the background; after the verse the band recovers and builds energy; Reviewer calls the Dark Star and The Other One both unbelievable [11][16]
- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (1 review): Considered one of the better versions of this song [12]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): The St. Stephen into It's A Sin and back into St. Stephen sequence stands out for the reviewer [16]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): The second set, starting with Morning Dew, is mind-blowing [19]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Energetic, with more slide guitar than usual [12]
- **Alligator** (1 review): The Alligator, Drums, Caution, The Eleven, Alligator, Caution, Feedback, Good Night run is raw and primal, with Jerry adding bursts of energy [17]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): The Eleven catches fire and flows back into Alligator, followed by the AWBYG riff; Alligator itself is somewhat sloppy [12]
- **Mountain Jam** (1 review): Reviewer believes a Mountain Jam melody tease at 3:32 of disc 3 track 4 is the earliest recorded one [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mountain Jam**: rare: 4 archived performances [21]
- **And We Bid You Good Night Jam**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]
- **14] "More! More! More!**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Not Fade Away tease**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.fixed.cribbs.28297.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 164 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd69-04-23.sbd.wise.70.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 165 min; rated 4.24/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Many cuts, but the recording is very strong; Cuts in the recording disrupted the reviewer's listening flow [17][18]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.98968.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 4.75/5 by 20 [3]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.barry.patched-fixed.98927.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes Boston's large student population and says the Ark is close to St. Stephen Street [16]
- Not as wild as the April 21st show, and the sound is somewhat weaker, though still high quality [9]
- Cites an Alligator reprise on 08-21-1968 at the Fillmore as the earliest Mountain Jam hint the reviewer has heard [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.fixed.cribbs.28297.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: MSR>C>D>CD (fix of http://db.etree.org/shninfo_detail.php?shnid=70) [1]. Also: Fixed version crossfades the St. Stephen/It's A Sin splice, trims 27 seconds from the Cryptical Envelopment reprise, and smooths jam and Caution splices [1]
- **gd69-04-23.sbd.wise.70.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jim Wise, Dr. Rob Bertrando, Darrin Sacks; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: A newer transfer by Charlie Miller circulating since November 2007 lists tape flips between St. Stephen and It's A Sin, during The Eleven, and between Caution and Feedback [19]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.miller.98968.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Soundboard to master cassette to cassette to FLAC; patches supply parts of Dark Star, St. Stephen and It's A Sin; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [3]
- **gd1969-04-23.sbd.barry.patched-fixed.98927.flac16**: transferred by Monte Barry; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: New source is speed corrected, dehissed and repatched, with disc track order fixed, using Charlie Miller's speed error specifications [4]
